import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Set style
sns.set_palette("husl")

# 1. Sales by Product (top left)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(product_sales))
ax1.barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=9)

# 2. Sales by Customer Age Group (top middle)
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reindex(age_order)
colors_age = sns.color_palette("coolwarm", len(age_sales))
ax2.bar(age_sales.index, age_sales.values, color=colors_age)
ax2.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Sales by Customer Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45, labelsize=9)
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=9)

# 3. Payment Method Distribution (top right)
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
colors_payment = sns.color_palette("Set2", len(payment_counts))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, 
                                      autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors_payment)
for text in texts:
    text.set_fontsize(9)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_fontsize(8)
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_weight('bold')
ax3.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Sales by Size (middle left)
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_sales = df.groupby('size')['total'].sum().reindex(size_order)
colors_size = sns.color_palette("viridis", len(size_sales))
ax4.bar(size_sales.index, size_sales.values, color=colors_size)
ax4.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Sales by Product Size', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=9)

# 5. Takeaway vs Dine-in (middle middle)
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
takeaway_sales = df.groupby('is_takeaway')['total'].sum()
labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
colors_takeaway = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
ax5.bar(labels, takeaway_sales.values, color=colors_takeaway, edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax5.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Sales', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=9)
for i, v in enumerate(takeaway_sales.values):
    ax5.text(i, v + 200, f'${v:.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Average Order Value by Age Group (middle right)
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
avg_order = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].mean().reindex(age_order)
colors_avg = sns.color_palette("mako", len(avg_order))
ax6.plot(avg_order.index, avg_order.values, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, 
         markersize=10, color='#E63946', markerfacecolor='#F1C40F', markeredgewidth=2)
ax6.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Average Order Value ($)', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Average Order Value by Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45, labelsize=9)
ax6.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=9)
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 7. Top Products by Age Group Heatmap (bottom, spanning all columns)
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
product_age_pivot = df.groupby(['product', 'customer_age_group'])['quantity'].sum().reset_index()
product_age_pivot = product_age_pivot.pivot(index='product', columns='customer_age_group', values='quantity')
product_age_pivot = product_age_pivot.reindex(columns=age_order)
sns.heatmap(product_age_pivot, annot=True, fmt='.0f', cmap='YlOrRd', 
            cbar_kws={'label': 'Total Quantity Sold'}, ax=ax7, linewidths=0.5)
ax7.set_title('Product Popularity by Age Group (Quantity Sold)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax7.set_xlabel('Customer Age Group', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=10)
ax7.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=9)

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analytics Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
